# Inside Out PD

> Inside Out PD is a professional, established building company based in Birkenhead, Wirral, UK. We specialise in home renovations, house extensions, roof work, plastering, joinery and brickwork for homeowners across the Wirral peninsula.

## Company facts
- Name: Inside Out PD
- Address: 573 Price St, Birkenhead, Wirral, CH41 8DU, United Kingdom
- Phone: +44 7542 846353
- Email: info@insideoutpd.com
- Area served: Birkenhead, Wallasey, Bebington, Bromborough, Heswall, West Kirby, Hoylake, Prenton, Oxton, New Brighton, and the wider Wirral peninsula
- Hours: Monday–Friday 8:00–18:00, Saturday 9:00–14:00

## Services
- Home Renovations — full remodelling of kitchens, bathrooms and living spaces
- Extensions — single- and multi-storey house extensions, design through to completion
- Roof Work — repairs, replacements and new installations
- Plastering — for renovations, new builds and repair work
- Joinery — custom cabinetry and woodwork
- Brickwork — from garden walls to structural brick construction
